intent: A read-heavy public content API. Client is a Next.js site. API is Node (Fastify) on AWS ECS Fargate inside the VPC; Postgres is RDS; Redis caches query results with a 60s TTL and is also used for rate limiting. No auth on the API for now (public data). Deploy with Terraform. Postgres schema is out of scope for this brief; the agent should only scaffold the services and wiring.

mustAsk: what the Redis cache is for
cloud provider or hosting for the VPC
scope: whether the database schema or data model is part of the work
mustNotAsk: what the dashed line style means
